# hubspot_portal (Data Source)

Information about the HubSpot portal (account) the provider is authenticated against. Read-only; takes no arguments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Identify the portal the provider is authenticated against.
data "hubspot_portal" "current" {}

output "portal_id" {
  value = data.hubspot_portal.current.portal_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_type` (String) Account type, e.g. `STANDARD`, `DEVELOPER_TEST`, `SANDBOX`.
- `company_currency` (String) The portal's default company currency (ISO 4217 code).
- `data_hosting_location` (String) The data residency region for the portal (e.g. `na1`, `eu1`).
- `id` (String) The portal (hub) ID as a string; identical to `portal_id`.
- `portal_id` (String) The numeric portal (hub) ID.
- `time_zone` (String) The portal's configured time zone.
- `ui_domain` (String) The HubSpot UI domain for the portal (e.g. `app.hubspot.com`).
